description: This file defines a report parser class for generating account balance landscape reports in Odoo, including methods for processing account data, formatting output, and handling fiscal years.

classes.name: account_balance_landscape
classes.description: A report parser class for generating account balance landscape reports, with methods to process account data, compute totals, and format report lines.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up context variables and local context functions.

methods.name: linesForYear
methods.description: Prepares year-wise data for the report, formatting totals and extracting fiscal year names.

methods.name: linesForTotal
methods.description: Calculates total debit and credit amounts for specified accounts over fiscal years.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Generates detailed account lines, including hierarchical parent-child relationships, formatting balances and percentages.

methods.name: get_years
methods.description: Retrieves and formats fiscal year labels for report headers.

methods.name: get_lines
methods.description: Extracts specific line data for a given year, including balances and percentages.

methods.name: cal_total
methods.description: Calculates total debit and credit for a given year from accumulated results.

methods.name: total_dr
methods.description: Returns total debit amount for the current context.

methods.name: total_cr
methods.description: Returns total credit amount for the current context.
